We are interested in starting a societal debate about democracy or anti-democracy and invite people to participate and express themselves. It is possible to chat with the political leader. We are interested in holding voter meetings 😊

[the operator] has some guest performers in mind, we are thinking of applying for support for events in the municipality and possibly other municipalities or is there a special fund we can apply to regarding the Culture Week?
